title: Belzer Chossid Passes Away
body: Rabbi Avraham Shalom Rabinowitz, a veteran Belz chassid in Yerushalayim, has passed away at 88. He was a respected elder chassid and early resident of Kiryas Belz.

title: Rav Piltz Rejects Draft Bill
body: Rav Aviezer Piltz, rosh yeshiva of Tifrach, publicly rejects the new draft bill backed by Degel HaTorah and Shas, sparking a political storm within Degel HaTorah.
